transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because things got a bit out of hand recently. I took on this project for the historical society, and I just acted like I could run the entire fundraiser all by myself. I started drawing up quilt designs, calling up volunteers, making all these schedules... and promising deadlines that I just couldn't possibly meet.
During this period of high activity, have you noticed that you need much less sleep than usual, but still feel full of energy the next day?

Yes, that's exactly how it was. For a while there, I was sleeping only a few hours a night... but I'd wake up completely ready to sew or start making phone calls right at dawn. I just didn't feel tired at all. 

But it's changed recently. Now I either just lie awake at night worrying about everything, or I end up sleeping really late and still feel completely worn out when I finally do get up.

Before this recent period of high energy, had you ever had episodes in the past where you felt unusually elevated, energetic, or irritable, or times when you felt significantly depressed for weeks at a time?

No, I don't really think so. I mean, I've had times where I was busy or maybe a little down, just like anyone else, but... nothing like this. I haven't ever felt this wired or this exhausted before. This is all pretty new to me.
How long did that period of feeling unusually energetic and needing little sleep last—was it more like a few days, a week, or longer?
Well, that whole overdriven stretch with the historical society project... it actually went on for about five months before everything just completely fell apart.
Over the past couple of weeks, how much have these low, worn-out feelings affected your ability to do everyday things—work, self-care, or being around others—compared to before?

It's affected me quite a bit, honestly. I've just... well, I stopped keeping my commitments entirely. My husband has actually had to step in and take over all the normal household routines. He's even the one dealing with the historical society right now, because I just couldn't face the people who were waiting on me to finish things. I just haven't been able to handle any of it.

During this low period, have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life, or experienced any unusual beliefs or perceptions, like hearing things others don't or feeling convinced of something others say isn't true?

No, I haven't heard or seen anything that isn't there, or believed anything unusual. And... I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Then nobody would have to deal with the mess I've made of everything.
